# FR-001-001 — Alpha rule

The system SHALL keep alpha records.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-001-001-01 — Given an alpha record, when it is saved, then it is stored.
- AC-001-001-02 — Given no alpha record, when it is read, then nothing is returned.
